history.new:
For base sequences G_k = a_1 G_(k-1) + ... + a_d G_(k-d) with a_1 >= a_2 >= ... >= a_d >= 1 and canonical
initial values (the conditions of Grabner-Petho-Tichy-Woeginger 1994), the circle product o_s is
associative once the shift s is large enough. (The earlier title, "Pisot base sequences ...", overstated
the published theorem.)
history.old:
For base sequences satisfying the dominant-root conditions of Grabner-Petho-Tichy-Woeginger (1994), the
circle product is associative once the shift parameter is large enough.

history.new: Published theorem (P. J. Grabner, A. Petho, R. F. Tichy, G. J. Woeginger, Appl. Math. Lett. 7 (1994) 85-90); see also A. Messaoudi, Math. Slovaca 50 (2000) 135-148 (window criterion, Thm 2-3). Not re-proved by the lab; our data agree for the sequences tested. The sequence G(k+1) = G(k) + G(k-3) (no associative shift <= 20) may be outside the theorem's hypotheses (Historian audit, reviews/historian_C03_C10.md).
history.old: Published theorem (Grabner, Petho, Tichy, Woeginger, "Associativity of recurrence multiplication", Appl. Math. Lett. 7 (1994) 85-90). We have not re-verified their proof; our data confirm it for 31 Pisot sequences (one, with |beta| ~ 0.94, not yet associative at s <= 20).
